verdict.rationale: The dashboard docs recommend creating a dedicated API key for each agent, script, or pipeline and revoking it independently. That gives per-agent credential isolation and limits blast radius. However, nothing shows keys can be restricted to particular endpoints, operations, or spend. The MCP OAuth sign-in only wraps an existing API key, so it adds no scoping. missing for 10: permission/endpoint scopes on keys, per-key spend or rate limits, key expiry, independent corroboration.
